external_references.description: Unit 42. (2025, December 11). Hamas-Affiliated Ashen Lepus Targets Middle Eastern Diplomatic Entities With New AshTag Malware Suite. Retrieved April 20, 2026.

objects.description: [AshTag](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9031) has masqueraded as a legitimate VisualServer utility.(Citation: Palo Alto Ashen Lepus DEC 2025)
